messages:
Noah K.: Hi team, first-day check-in: laptop arrived but the monitor + TB dock tracking (LP554433221US) says 'Delivered to Front Desk' but nothing at desk 2F-08. Also can't join SSID 'Redwood-Staff' - getting '802.1X: authentication failed'. I filed ticket #6780.

IT Helpdesk Bot: Ticket #6780 created and assigned to Jules (IT). Expected reply in ~20m.

Jules (IT): Welcome Noah! Can you paste the carrier number? Meanwhile try 'Redwood-Guest' and check the onboarding email for a temp token. What OS are you on?

Noah K.: Carrier: LP554433221US. I'm on macOS 13.6. I don't see a guest token in the onboarding email.

Priya - Mailroom: Hey @Noah K., LP554433221US is on Shelf 'New Hires-A' tagged '2F'. I can deliver to 2F-08 in ~10m or you can pick it up. :package:

Jules (IT): DMing a guest token now. If 802.1X keeps failing on Mac, remove any old profiles: System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Profiles, then run in Terminal:

```
sudo profiles renew -type wifi
```

and restart Wi-Fi.

Network Team Bot: Noted. If the client still rejects auth we've queued a cert reissue (NW-310).

Noah K.: Ran the profiles renew and restarted Wi-Fi, still see '802.1X: authentication failed'.

Jules (IT): Pushing cert refresh to your account now. Also when popup appears, choose 'Use System' and enter your SSO email (not local computer account). Try again in ~30s.

Noah K.: Connected! :tada: Priya just dropped the monitor + dock at my desk. Quick question: the dock fan is a bit loud when plugged in. Is that expected?

Jules (IT): Some docks spin a small fan when powering displays or charging. Try swapping the USB-C cable first and check monitor power mode. If it stays loud we'll swap the dock unit — ping me and I'll arrange a replacement.

Priya - Mailroom: Note: swap units available at Mailroom-A during business hours.

Noah K.: All good for now, everything working. Huge thanks for the rapid help everyone! :smile:
